entities.name: Hormgart
entities.description: A dwarven skald living his afterlife in the great hall of Starnheim.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Great hall where heroes from all realms gather eternally.

entities.name: Njala
entities.description: Valkyrie shepherd who sought Hormgart to learn about Arni Brokenbrow.

entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: Mortal warrior whose exploits caught Njala's attention.

events.summary: Njala sought out Hormgart in Starnheim to learn about Arni Brokenbrow.
events.quote: the Valkyrie shepherd Njala sought out Hormgart to learn more about Arni Brokenbrow

events.summary: Hormgart recounted how Goatleaper defeated trolls in the Tusk Mountains and became Arni Brokenbrow.
events.quote: Arni emerged victorious, with a troll's bone embedded in his forehead

relations.quote: Hormgart is a dwarven skald, who is living his afterlife in the great hall of Starnheim
